verdict.rationale: BILL runs several built-in automations in the background: vendor autopay pays a bill as soon as it is created, the Invoice Coding Agent codes bills with AI, transactions are auto-categorized and checked for compliance, and accounting sync runs both ways automatically. Custom approval policies and webhook subscriptions let users wire up their own event-driven flows, but only by building against the API. These are mostly fixed product behaviors or developer integrations rather than background automations a user configures. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or rules builder for Spend & Expense, autonomous agent workflows beyond invoice coding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
